note: Merged/ready real issue about honoring reviewPolicy in advisory-convergence; today's A4.5 verifiability check false-positives on its own policy-conditional prose (known lexical-gate boundary gap).
title: feat(advisory-convergence): honor reviewPolicy when deciding applicability
body:
## Background

Parent roadmap: #2141

`reviewPolicy` already exists on `.github/idd/config.json`
(`copilot-advisory` / `human-required` / `no-advisory` /
`external-bot`). Profile artifacts under `idd-template/profiles/`
tell an adopter to strip Copilot wait language from the phase files.

`advisory-convergence.mts` never reads `reviewPolicy`. Once the
optional workflow is registered as a required check, every applicable
PR is judged as a Copilot-advisory PR — including a repository that
chose `human-required` or `no-advisory`.
`advisoryWait.exemptBotAuthoredPrs` does not help: a human-authored
PR is never exempted.

`idd-claimed` is the wrong substitute. A hybrid PR that closes an IDD
issue becomes applicable and then demands Copilot. That is the
gradual-adoption shape.

The profile READMEs also never tell the adopter to set
`reviewPolicy` in config or to leave the workflow unregistered. The
field and the required check can disagree in silence.

## Proposed change

Make the convergence applicability (or an equivalent early
short-circuit that yields `ready` through `not_applicable`, not
through a fake `converged`) honor `reviewPolicy`:

- `copilot-advisory`, absent, or an invalid value: current behavior
  (fail-closed).
- `human-required` and `no-advisory`: Copilot clauses do not apply.
  Human approval and conversation resolution stay on branch
  protection / the phase files, not on this check.
- `external-bot`: keep using the configured primary advisory bot
  (already the non-Copilot path).

Add `reviewPolicy` (and "do not register `idd-advisory-convergence`
as required unless this policy actually wants an advisory-bot
check") to the `human-required` and `no-advisory` profile patch
surfaces so a later session does not re-host the check against a
human-only policy.

Do not invent a new `convergenceScope` value in this issue. Do not
treat a trusted human approve as a silent Copilot substitute under
`copilot-advisory`.

## Acceptance criteria

- With `reviewPolicy: human-required` or `no-advisory`,
  `advisory-convergence --assert` exits 0 on a fixture PR that has no
  Copilot review and no waiver.
- With `reviewPolicy` absent or `copilot-advisory`, the same fixture
  still fails until Copilot converges or a valid waiver applies
  (today's behavior).
- An invalid `reviewPolicy` value does not widen applicability past
  today's `copilot-advisory` behavior.
- `idd-template/profiles/human-required/README.md` and
  `no-advisory/README.md` list the config field and the "do not
  register this check unless you want an advisory-bot gate" note on
  the same patch surface as the phase-file edits.
- Schema / helper-script / customization docs name the new reading
  of `reviewPolicy`.
- Tests cover the three policy branches above.
- `pnpm test` and `pnpm run lint:minimum` pass.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`
- `schemas/policy.schema.json` (description only if the enum is
  unchanged)
- `idd-template/profiles/human-required/README.md`
- `idd-template/profiles/no-advisory/README.md`
- `docs/customization.md`, `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`,
  `docs/idd-review-policy-profiles.md` (and `idd-template/` mirrors)
- `tests/advisory-convergence.test.mts`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented._
